explication: Dolibarr is a modular ERP/CRM web application for managing an organization’s sales, purchasing, finance, products, people, and collaboration. Users work through optional business modules; the documented sales lifecycle includes proposals, orders, and invoices, with a workflow trigger creating linked downstream objects. The graph preserves major README capabilities and shows the sampled workflow ownership. Most module internals were not sampled, so their feature areas are shown without speculative call chains.
